features.name: Passenger Mirror Dip on Reverse Gear
features.description: Automatically angles passenger exterior mirror downward when reverse gear is engaged to assist kerb parking.

features.name: Scandinavian DRL (Rear Tail Lights Active with DRL)
features.description: Keeps rear LED/bulb taillights illuminated together with front Daytime Running Lights during daylight.

features.name: Acoustic Lock Confirmation (Infotainment Menu)
features.description: Enables lock/unlock acoustic beep setting inside the MIB / Discover Media vehicle settings menu.

features.name: Deactivate DRL when Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) Set
features.description: Switches off daytime running lights whenever vehicle is stationary with parking brake applied.

features.name: Dynamic Cornering Lights via Fog Lamps
features.description: Fades fog lamp on and off smoothly during cornering maneuvers or indicator usage.

features.name: Highway Comfort Turn Signals
features.description: Cycles indicator flash pulses upon soft touch of indicator stalk.

features.name: Front Windscreen Teardrop Wipe
features.description: Performs one delayed wipe across front screen 5 seconds after screenwash spray.

features.name: Rear Wiper on Reverse Gear
features.description: Automatically runs rear wiper when selecting reverse gear if front wipers are active.

features.name: Coming Home / Leaving Home with Fog Lights
features.description: Uses fog lights instead of xenon/LED low beams for Coming Home lighting to extend bulb life.
